title: O(1) LRU cache
prompt: Implement a header-only class template `LruCache<Key, Value>` in the global namespace.
- `explicit LruCache(std::size_t capacity)`; a capacity of 0 means the cache never stores anything.
- `std::optional<Value> get(const Key& key)` returns a copy of the value and marks the entry most recently used.
- `void put(const Key& key, Value value)` inserts or updates. Updating an existing key also marks it most recently used. Inserting into a full cache evicts the least recently used entry.
- `bool contains(const Key& key) const` must NOT change recency.
- All operations must be O(1) on average. `Key` is hashable with `std::hash` and equality comparable.
